name: Mao Zedong
role: Chinese Communist Party chairman (1943–1976) and leader of the People’s Republic of China
summary: Mao advocated Communist Party leadership, socialist public ownership, collective agriculture and continuing class struggle. His revolutionary mass campaigns sought to transform political authority and culture as well as economic production; his later diplomacy pursued cooperation against Soviet power.
